recurrence.question: Which backlog items belong to one recurring defect class?

stale-closure.question: Which backlog rows say 'open' while the code says the work landed?
stale-closure.method: cross-artifact: row status vs. closing markers in core/ bin/ tests/ scripts/

notes.TD-012: Markers exist but read 'TD-012 tracks consolidating this shipped-runtime story' — i.e. they describe it as STILL OPEN. It was genuinely 2/3 done. Neither credited nor penalised.
notes.TD-013: Zero markers anywhere. The fix (findRoot made sibling-aware) never cited the id, so no marker-based detector can find it. Scored as ambiguous rather than pretending v1 covers it.
notes.must_not_fire: These three are already 'resolved'. They are in the corpus because their descriptions carry pipes — BUG-007 'apply_patch\|shell', BUG-028 'Edit\|Write', BUG-027 an UNESCAPED one — and a detector that splits rows on every '|' misreads their status column. That is not hypothetical: it is the exact bug that made the 2026-07-28 manual audit report seven stale entries with two P1s when the truth was four and zero.
